evidence_quotes.O: Lens scales are engraved and filled with enamel, adding to the vintage vibe of the optic.
evidence_quotes.C: Plastics are high quality and the barrel is well finished in semi-matte. I could detect no wobble or play in the mount or zoom extension.
evidence_quotes.E: slid on the VF-4 and was propelled into eyeball Nirvana! The 2.36 dot display is a knockout: remarkable clarity
evidence_quotes.A: It's as if Crumpler designers actually test and use their creations for photography!
evidence_quotes.N: Not my favorite color--Crumpler calls it "snot" green--but makes it easy to see inside! Lining is ultra soft and won't scratch camera delicates.
